self.title: Integrating Autonomous Multi-Agent Frameworks and Curiosity-Driven Exploration for Open-Ended Discovery

detail.title: Integrating Autonomous Multi-Agent Frameworks and Curiosity-Driven Exploration for Open-Ended Discovery
detail.summary: Autonomous problem formulation benefits from multi-agent collaboration and intrinsic curiosity. However, systemic limitations—such as non-convex scalarization in objective learning—constrain the ability of these systems to independently prioritize diverse, non-trivial research problems.
detail.reason: Revising to integrate the constraint of non-convex scalarization identified in the objective discovery research.

detail.title: Mechanisms for Autonomous Problem Formulation
detail.question: How can an artificial process independently identify, evaluate, and prioritize novel research problems without explicit external instruction?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project alignment with unassigned problem formulation.

detail.title: Progress in Autonomous Objective and Inquiry Systems
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes new research on multi-objective reinforcement learning and its implications for autonomous objective discovery and inquiry systems, focusing on non-convex scalarization and Pareto-efficient policy learning.
